releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
Minor tweaks and several translations.
- Chinese translation by Nan
- Korean translation by Barirn
- French translation by LaraNanuq
- Russian translation by HanSoloCh
- Minor ship log and text adjustments
- Dropping a Nomai orb now drops it until you look away rather than re-selecting it after a delay
- Other extremely minor gameplay and level design tweaks
releases.bodyZh:
次要调整和若干翻译。
- 中文翻译由Nan完成
- 韩文翻译由Barirn完成
- 法文翻译由LaraNanuq完成
- 俄文翻译由HanSoloCh完成
- 船员日志和文本的微小调整
- 现在丢弃一个挪麦球体会在你移开视线之前持续掉落，而不是在延迟后重新选择
- 其他极其微小的游戏玩法和关卡设计调整

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
Added developer commentary!
- Commentary can be enabled from the options menu
- Extensive commentary has been placed throughout most of the mod's points of interest
- Use your signalscope to locate and warp to commentary
- Some commentary includes demonstrations

One Single Minor Design Tweak:
- The torches on a signal-related puzzle now change to a new color when the puzzle is solved
releases.bodyZh:
已添加开发者评论！
- 评论可以在选项菜单中启用
- 大量的评论已被放置在模组大部分的兴趣点
- 使用您的信号仪定位并跃迁到评论
- 部分评论包含演示

一个单一的小设计调整：
- 当谜题解决时，与信号相关的谜题上的火把会变成新的颜色

releases.name: Version 1.0.4
releases.body:
Lots of minor design changes based on watching people play over the last week.
- Prevented clipping into ice when warping under certain circumstances
- Made a beacon taller so it's more visible from a greater distance
- Minor structure edits to reduce clipping and make some texts harder to miss
- The buried portion of a certain structure now includes an interior
- A signal-related structure has been made more visually distinct and visible from a greater distance
- Minor text and ship log updates
- Scaled up a secret warp receiver to make it less likely to strand you in deep space
- Moved a deadly dialog option to the end of the list
- Daucus has been tinted redder to make it more easily distinguishable from The Big One
- Certain Nomai text spirals have been re-positioned to be easier to target with the translator
releases.bodyZh:
基于过去一周观察玩家游戏进行的许多小设计改动。
- 防止在特定情况下传送时穿透冰块
- 将信标的高度增加，使其从更远距离更容易看到
- 对一些结构进行微调以减少穿透并使部分文字更难错过
- 某个结构的埋藏部分现在包含内部空间
- 某个与信号相关的结构已被设计得更具视觉辨识度，且从更远距离可见
- 对部分文字和飞船日志进行更新
- 将一个秘密传送接收器的尺寸放大，以降低你在深空迷失的可能性
- 将一个致命的对话框选项移至列表末尾
- Daucus(达科斯)的红色调被加深，使其更容易与The Big One(巨大之物)区分
- 某些挪麦文本螺旋已被重新定位，以便用翻译器更容易锁定目标
